uncheckedSendable.rationale: Immutable transfer object whose Foundation payload is created before crossing the task boundary.
Value wrapper delegates access to the thread-safe UserDefaults implementation and stores no mutable reference state.
Error snapshot is immutable and only carries value descriptions across the task boundary.
URLSession owns delegate callbacks and the implementation has no mutable instance state.
All JSONDecoder access is serialized by the wrapper lock.
Connection mutations are serialized on the receiver queue.
Listener and connection state are confined to the receiver queue.
Collected output is protected by an internal lock.
Process lifecycle state is protected by an internal lock and single completion path.
Cancellation state is synchronized by the token lock.
Testable in-memory credential storage is protected by the coordinator lock.
The coordinator is the serialization primitive for token mutations.
All mutable credential operations are serialized by the mutation coordinator.
Service dependencies are immutable and each operation uses isolated local state.
Mutable database access is delegated to its serialized database boundary.
Service is stateless; request-local Vision and PDF objects never escape an operation.
Service configuration is immutable and request work is operation-local.
URLSession operation state is synchronized by its lock and single completion path.
URLSession owns delegate callbacks and the implementation is final, stateless, and only rejects redirects.
Value service stores immutable sendable command dependencies; filesystem objects remain operation-local.
Preview output buffers are protected by the collector lock.
Process lifecycle mutations are protected by the service lock.
Rule values are immutable; the regular expression is constructed once and only used for matching.
Mutable repository-path cache access is serialized by the instance lock; immutable publishing dependencies conform to Sendable.
Wrapper exposes only documented thread-safe FileManager operations and has no mutable state.
JSONDecoder access is serialized by the wrapper lock.
JSONEncoder access is serialized by the wrapper lock.
SQLite access and mutable database state are confined to the database queue.
Commit sequencing state is protected by the coordinator lock.
Revision counters are protected by the state lock.
Test probe state is protected by its lock and is only used to assert cancellation.
Test transport observations are protected by the probe lock.
Test gate state is protected by its synchronization primitive.
Test recorder mutations are protected by its lock.
Test commit coordination state is protected by its lock and continuation handoff.
